## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat` — New feature

## Checklist

- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] I've run `pnpm lint` with no errors
- [ ] I've run `pnpm build` successfully
- [ ] No `any`, unnarrowed `unknown`, or unnecessary `never` types
- [ ] I've tested my changes locally
